title: config/targets.yaml — ranked target roles + intake quotas + geography

geography.description: The candidate's location constraints — replaces hardcoded geography in evaluation rules.

work_modes.description: Working arrangements the user will accept. Asked explicitly at setup, never inferred from a CV.

max_commute_minutes.description: One-way commute tolerance, for onsite/hybrid roles.

employment.description: Engagement types the user will consider — matched at hunt time against the job row's employment_type.

types.description: Acceptable types. Absent or empty means no preference was recorded.

exclude.description: Hard rejects — a posting of this type is skipped, not down-scored.

baseline_years.description: Years of in-cluster experience; seniority match is scored by years REQUIRED in the JD, not by title.

targets.description: Ordered, rank 1 first. Only the top target is needed for the first result; the rest can be deferred to the queue.

cluster.description: Cluster id from the pack's roles.yaml.

queries.description: Per-language search queries, keyed by ISO 639-1 code.

calibration.description: /optimise-owned block: observed response evidence behind threshold choices. Runs never edit this; /optimise proposes, the user approves.
